meta.purpose: LNG terminal tags, 17 November 2026: AssociatedWithLNGExports (yes when a validated source ties this pipeline or expansion to LNG export, directly or as feedgas supply), AssociatedLNGTerminal (terminal names as GEM's LNG tracker writes them), and AssociatedLNGNotes, with the new shared AssociatedLNG [ref]. Covers every US gas row (brief: BRIEF.md in this folder).
